_comment: Real 11th edition tournament score statistics used to calibrate the Combat Calc forecast (tests/calc-calibration.test.mjs). Aggregates only.
source: Stat Check 'The Meta' dashboard (https://www.stat-check.com/the-meta), 11th edition, events of 25+ players, launch (June 2026) to mid-November 2026; read 2026-11-20. First-turn figures: 40k-analytics (https://40k-analytics.github.io/stateofthegame/, 151,665 matches, 17 Nov 2026) and Listhammer (https://listhammer.info/stats, 12,743 games).
notes: Scores under 20 are hidden on the dashboard (about 3.7% of rows) and blowouts are often entered as 100, so the 100 spike is somewhat inflated and the true mean is 75-77.
